name: Required Reason: disk space
plain: iOS free and total storage need 85F4.1, E174.1, 7D9E.1 or B728.1.
meaning: Exact free bytes are near-unique. 85F4.1 shows space to the user, E174.1 checks room before writing, 7D9E.1 adds to a user-sent bug report, B728.1 is for health research apps.

android.api_surface: Android has no gate: StatFs is open

ios.revocation: App Review: no off-device use except listed
ios.api_surface: 85F4.1 show to user (LAN to own device ok with consent); E174.1 behavior must change by space; 7D9E.1 bug report; B728.1 health research apps

limits.headline: Can check your free storage on iPhone only with a stated reason, and freely on Android
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it starts or before a download
can: Show you how much space is left, one allowed reason on iPhone
Change its behavior when space is low, another allowed reason
Include space in a bug report you send, another allowed reason
Check space on Android with no gate at all
cannot: Check space on iPhone without picking one of the listed reasons
Use the number to track you, or send it elsewhere, under the rules
Ignore Apple's check; submissions are reviewed since 1 May 2024
limits.reach_label: A number, with a stated reason
limits.differs: Android has no gate. iPhone requires one of four declared reasons.

story.what_it_is: iOS makes apps give an approved reason before reading free storage space.

marketing.name: Required Reason APIs
marketing.pitch: Developer rule: apps must declare an approved reason for using sensitive APIs like disk space, which can be used for fingerprinting.

story.for_you: You never see this rule. It makes apps say why they check free space, so a game cannot quietly use the exact number as a tag on your phone.
story.for_makers: Makers must pick a reason code, like 85F4.1 to show space to the user or E174.1 to check room before saving. Using the number for tracking is not allowed.

use_cases.example: A movie app checks free space before a download and declares reason E174.1.
A cleaner app shows free space to you and declares reason 85F4.1.
A research app that records large files declares reason B728.1.
A developer adds free space to a bug report you send, with reason 7D9E.1.
An ad SDK that reads free space for fingerprinting gets flagged and the app is rejected.
A game checks room for an update download before starting it.

story.android_note: Android has no matching rule for disk space.
story.ios_note: Enforced through the privacy manifest, with checks on App Store uploads.
